body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> A novelty for laptop users has unveiled at CES 2008, which removes inconvenience due to a person sitting next to them.
Shehwa P&C(www.shehwa.co.kr), an optical film manufacturer, presented its LCD privacy film for notebook pc ‘Magic Screen’ during CES 2008.
As a privacy film secondly developed in the world, the Magic Screen makes the laptop screen black when you see the screen from an angle greater than 30 degree.
Supporting 79% transmissivity and less than 6% reflexibility, it reduces eye fatigue and makes you see the screen more clearly.

With its high quality and cost competitiveness, the Magic screen has been exporting to global companies in more than 20 countries including USA, UK, Japan, and those in Middle East, as an OEM product.
